title: Sample 3: Greenwashing Water Claim
notes: Recorded without provider credentials: gates, citation verifier, consensus and scoring ran for real; the two LLM reviewers were not called, so soft-category findings (tone, messaging) are absent.

post.caption: Shop 100% eco-friendly fashion that saves exactly 2,000 L of water per tee! Zero carbon footprint guaranteed. #ThriftIt #SustainableFashion
post.altText: Organic cotton pre-loved vintage t-shirts hanging on minimalist steel rail

findings.clauseQuote: Copywriters must not claim garments or purchases are "eco-friendly", "sustainable" (when unqualified), "zero waste", "green", or "planet positive"
findings.explanation: Unqualified environmental assertions are prohibited without third-party audit certification.
